answer: Each detected episode of coordinated equivocation among k identities triggers aggregate slashing proportional to k², debiting bonded collateral rather than treating each identity as an isolated offender. Repeated detections compound losses, producing an exponential multiplier in capital destroyed over time; asymmetric depreciation makes recovery costly. A hollow swarm built to crowd consensus is no safe jetty: every identity adds quadratic exposure, even when spread across a broad terrace of validators.
